[by Claude Code]

Fixes #45366

## Motivation

`test_per_token_group_quant.py::test_masked_post_quant_writes_exactly_the_real_rows` fails on `main` with `ImportError: cannot import name 'silu_and_mul_contig_post_quant' from 'sglang.kernels.ops.moe.dsv4'`, which breaks `jit-kernel-unit-test-4-gpu-b200` (e.g. https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/39393626348/job/118531172346).

#44618 added the test with an import from `moe.dsv4`, and #45112 then moved `silu_and_mul_contig_post_quant` to `activation.silu_and_mul_clamp`, updating only the sibling test's import.

## Modifications

Import `silu_and_mul_contig_post_quant` from `sglang.kernels.ops.activation.silu_and_mul_clamp` in that test, matching the sibling test at line 326. `silu_and_mul_masked_post_quant` is still imported from `sglang.kernels.ops.moe.dsv4`. Test-only change.

## Accuracy Tests

Not applicable (test import only).

## Speed Tests and Profiling

Not applicable.

## Validation

- On `main`, `from sglang.kernels.ops.moe.dsv4 import silu_and_mul_contig_post_quant` raises the `ImportError`; with this change both imports resolve, and pytest collects all 121 tests in the file.
- The kernel test itself needs a B200 GPU and was not run locally; CI will confirm.
- `pre-commit run --all-files` passes.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [ ] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [ ] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).
